author: AI writing agent; source checking is not human mechanic certification
method: Individually authored original explanations after reading each Ford1999 DTC description row and its explicit cross-references. Pinpoint/chart evidence added for sparse rows and PSP circuit distinctions. Code-specific decisions are distinguished from exact service instructions. No article-generation template was used for prose.
scope: US-market1999 Ford PCED, plus expressly identified strategy variants within that historical document. Manufacturer codes are Ford namespace only; no modern-vehicle or other-make applicability inferred.

sourceAcquisition.comparisonToPriorAcquisition: HTML is identical after removing dynamic telemetry scripts and normalizing whitespace. Diagnostic rows did not change.
sourceAcquisition.additionalSources: Existing directly retrieved OEM chart and pinpoint HTML documents; sections identified per article.
sourceAcquisition.externalSearchStatus: Web search service open returned an error; direct official OEM URL retrieval succeeded.

validation.metadata: All parseable JSON, draftstatus, known source IDs and truthful HTML locators; no invented PDF pages
validation.internalSimilarity: No pairs at five-word Jaccard>=0.45 after removing headings/footer and normalizing codes/numbers; highest0.0271. Not a semantic or factual certification.

limits: These manuscripts are drafts and are not wired into the public renderer by this writing batch.
Historical source errors and dictionary conflicts remain explicitly marked rather than silently repaired.
Full OEM diagnostic trees, pinouts and copyrighted manual prose were not republished.
A shared source-supported procedure may recur for true companion codes; no fabricated differences added.
